## Deferrals read

`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — read at run start (2026-09-26). No OPEN row is unblocked by this
ticket's scope (P1.19 is new surface work, not a live-verify of a prior deferred leg). New
`D-P1.19-*` rows append at run end for the Stage-B legs.

## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. **In-app channel on the PRB.09 event stream** — every §5.11 event type gets an in-app row
   (collapse key = run id, update-in-place), the two non-configurable rows enforced, quiet hours
   deferring only run-finished + chat, OS-level only when unfocused (client presence rule;
   push/native is 1.x — the `NotificationTransport` seam stays named).
2. **`/app/inbox`** — one ordering (blocked-on-you by soonest deadline → unread finished runs →
   stale voices), badge counting only approvals + decisions, Needs-you `ApprovalRow` reuse with
   the side-sheet read-first Approve, server-side read state (REQ-MOBILE-19).
3. **Decisions rows** — standing escalations, escalated obligations, horizon-expired deferrals
   ("decide / re-defer / drop"), §6.8 stall escalations for hand-run rounds; re-defer/drop route
   through P0.12's real obligation transitions.
4. **Returning to a finished run** (REQ-IDE-48) — `/p/:project` with an unread finished run lands
   on the walkthrough card with the deliverable on the Page (letter for reviews, what-changed for
   revisions, v1 for drafts).
5. **Quiet hours + prefs** — `quietHours` through the in-app channel; prefs per event type,
   server-side, shared web/mobile; spend_gate + trial_payment refuse API disable.
6. **Phone-width web (<~768 px)** — reader-only Page + the §10.1 input set (gate actions with
   estimate, five dispositions with a note, text-only chat); the ✗ column (run-start, run config,
   rigor/model/voice building, ingestion, diffs, billing, export, new project, bulk accept/apply,
   approval-field editing) never renders; app banner only behind a shipped-app flag; §5.1
   intermediate breakpoints; usage levels 0–1 read-only.
7. **Deferred email rows** — voice-stale weekly digest, day-12 trial, payment-failed (P1.16's
   billing events already enqueue), optional hourly run-finished digest, product updates off by
   default; signed Wait-for-me/Open only — never Approve.
8. **Stage B** — live legs green or `D-P1.19-*` deferrals with owners.

## Implementation notes

- `inbox_items` (0002) already exists (`id,user_id,project_id,kind,payload,read_at`); migration
  `0039` adds `collapse_key`/`visible_at`/`run_id` + the collapse unique index.
- `notification_prefs` is a per-user JSONB blob — the schema gains `inApp`, `digest`, `project`
  scopes beside `email` + `quietHours`.
- In-app delivery rides the SAME `notify` job arms the mailer consumes (one event → both channels).

## Progress

- **`packages/contracts`** — `notifications.ts`: `NOTIFICATION_EVENT_TYPES` extended with the P1.19
  in-app rows (`run_cancelled_recovered`, `voice_stale`, `chat_reply`, `run_progress`,
  `product_update`); `NOTIFICATION_MATRIX` — one declarative row per event type carrying
  `inApp`/`push`/`email`/`defaultOn`/`configurable`/`osLevelOnlyWhenUnfocused`/
  `quietHoursDeferrable`/`collapse`; `EMAIL_EVENT_TYPES` = the email-capable subset (in-app-only
  rows have no template — the module self-check pins this); `QUIET_HOURS_DEFERRABLE` =
  `{run_finished, chat_reply}`; `notificationPrefsSchema` gained `inApp`/`digest`/`project`
  scopes beside `email` + `quietHours` (the shared web/mobile blob, REQ-MOBILE-19);
  `inAppEnabled`/`emailEnabled`/`digestMode`/`effectiveEmailMatrix`/`inQuietHours`/
  `quietHoursEnd`; EMAIL_TEMPLATES gained `voice_stale` (the weekly digest — the only voice
  mail), `chat_reply` (opt-in arm), `product_update` (opt-in, off by default);
  `DIGEST_TEMPLATES.run_finished_digest` (the optional hourly batch). Signed actions stay
  Wait-for-me/Open only — the no-Approve invariant is test-pinned across every template.
- **`packages/db`** — migration `0039_in_app_notifications.sql`: `inbox_items` gains
  `collapse_key`, `run_id`, `visible_at` + the per-user collapse unique index; Drizzle parity in
  `schema/misc.ts`.
- **`packages/findings-core`** — `inbox.ts` (new): `inboxOrder`/`inboxBlockedOrder`/
  `inboxBadgeCount`/`inboxGroups` — the ONE shared ordering (blocked-on-you by soonest deadline
  → unread events → read events → stale voices) and the badge rule (approvals + decisions only)
  that api, web, and the 1.x app share.
- **`packages/orchestrator`** — `inbox.ts` (new): `listInbox`/`listInboxGroups`/`readInboxBadge`/
  `markInboxItemRead`/`markInboxRunRead`/`markInboxRead` inside the caller's tenant tx (RLS
  enforced — rows resolve through `p.owner_id`); stale voices derive read-time through the moved
  `voice-status.ts` assembler (relocated verbatim from `apps/api` so the worker's digest sweep
  shares it — the api file re-exports). `notifications.ts`: `deliverInApp` (the in-app arm of
  every §5.11 event — upsert on `collapse_key`, `visible_at` = quiet end for the deferrable
  classes), `scheduleRunProgressNotification` (per-PROJECT opt-in only), `runLandingPath`
  (workflow → canonical §4.2 landing: reviews/fact-checks → dossier, draft-likes → `/v/working`,
  figures → `/figures`, slug-less → `/app/inbox`), the notify handlers for `voice_digest`
  (weekly), `trial_ending` (day-12) / payment-failed, `run_digest` (hourly opt-in), and
  `product_update` (opt-in); gate-expiry rides the same post-commit seam so a system cancel
  lands `run_cancelled_recovered` in-app and `completed_partial` mails nothing (failed-only).
  `email-actions.ts`: deep links now key on the project SLUG (`/p/:slug/…`), `runDeepLink`
  accepts the workflow-shaped `landingPath`, `billingDeepLink` → `/settings/billing`.
- **`packages/obligations`** — `discharge.ts`: a horizon-arrived deferral re-opens AND opens a
  `decision_requests` row ("decide / re-defer / drop") — idempotent, reuses an open request.
  `hook.ts`: `escalateStalls` fires for hand-run rounds too (§6.8; scoped runs stay scoped).
- **`apps/api`** — `notification-routes.ts`: `GET/PUT /notifications/prefs` extended to the
  `inApp`/`digest`/`project` scopes (non-configurable rows still reject with 400 — enforced at
  the route AND overridden in `emailEnabled`/`inAppEnabled`); `GET /inbox`, `GET /inbox/badge`,
  `POST /inbox/read`, `POST /inbox/read-run`, `POST /inbox/read-all`; the signed
  `GET /action/:token` consume re-reads the bound gate's project slug for the redirect.
  `triage-routes.ts`: a decision row carrying `obligation_id` resolves "re-defer"/"drop"
  through the real P0.12 transitions (`routeDisposition` defer / `mootObligation`) — "decide"
  and "dismiss" close the request only.
- **`apps/worker`** — `main.ts`: `notify.sweep.weekly` (Mon 04:45 UTC → voice digest),
  `notify.sweep.daily` (04:50 UTC → day-12 trial + payment-failed scan), `notify.sweep.hourly`
  (:55 → optional run digest); each fans out one singleton-keyed tenant-scoped `notify` job per
  workspace through the system client — a re-fired sweep is idempotent on delivery claims.
- **`apps/web`** — `/app/inbox` route + `InboxPage` (Needs-you / New·Earlier / Voices sections in
  the api's own order; a gate row's `<details>` expand is the MVP side-sheet — it mounts the
  real `GateCard` when the page joined it, so the artifact read precedes the Approve; read
  receipts + read-all forms; deep-link rows only carry ids + templated strings, REQ-MOBILE-20).
  `?gate=<id>` on a dossier mounts the focused card at the head of the artifact (the phone
  approve surface — the Timeline is `display:none` there). REQ-IDE-48: `/p/:project` with an
  unread finished run lands on the walkthrough card (the run's collapsed Inbox row marks read
  on open). **Phone width**: `isPhoneRequest` (`sec-ch-ua-mobile`/`Mobi|iPhone|Android` UA) →
  `compact` on `PageData` everywhere via `ideContext`; the generated CSS emits the §5.1 ladder
  (Margin→ticks <1280, single-column + bottom-sheet Timeline <1024, reader Page <768); compact
  suppresses run-start/run-config, ingestion/import, diffs/compare, billing, export, new-project,
  bulk accept/apply, approval-field editing, voice-building — and keeps the §10.1 input set:
  the focused gate card (Approve/Wait-for-me/Stop + estimate), the five dispositions with notes,
  and a compact text-only `ChatDesk` mounted inside the Page region. No app-banner markup exists
  at MVP. `api-client`/`data.ts`/`page-data.ts` carry the Inbox seams; the rail's Inbox
  shortcut now lands on `/app/inbox`.

## Gap table

| # | Gap found | Fix | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `EMAIL_TEMPLATES` self-check + tests demanded a template per event type, but §5.11 marks `run_cancelled_recovered`/`run_progress` in-app-only — mailing them would violate "failed only" | `EMAIL_EVENT_TYPES` (email-capable subset: `email !== "none"`) as the coverage domain; the test asserts the two excluded rows by name | contracts `notifications.test.ts` |
| 2 | `emailEnabled` read `defaultOn` for `opt_in` email rows — `chat_reply`'s optional arm defaulted ON (its `defaultOn:true` describes the Inbox arm), contradicting §5.11 "email optional" | `email === "opt_in"` ⇒ default `false` unless the stored pref turns it on | matrix test `m.chat_reply.enabled === false`, `inApp === true` |
| 3 | Test pre-dated the ticket's quiet set: expected `["run_finished"]` only | Ticket says "run-finished + chat" — `QUIET_HOURS_DEFERRABLE` + test carry both; gates/spend still never defer | contracts + orchestrator quiet-hours tests |
| 4 | `ideContext` didn't return `compact` — phone detection never reached half the routes | `ideContext` returns `compact: isPhoneRequest(c)`; every `renderDocument` path spreads it | web typecheck + `inbox-phone.test.ts` |
| 5 | The <768 CSS hides `.ide-desk`/`.ide-margin`/`.ide-timeline` — the allowed chat + gate inputs lived only inside them | Compact `ChatDesk` (text compose + estimate chip; no promote/run-start) mounted inside the Page region (`data-phone-chat`); `?gate=` dossier mounts the real card; `PageSurface`+`VersionRail` go read-only compact | `inbox-phone.test.ts` (12) |
| 6 | Test stubs missed real `DataSource` seams (`getApprovalOverrides`, `listVoiceGroups`) | Stubs aligned to the interface — the 500s were fixture gaps, not route defects | web suite green |
| 7 | Email deep links keyed on the project UUID while web routes key on the slug — a mailed Open would 404 | `gateDeepLink`/`runDeepLink` take `projectSlug`; the action consume re-reads it server-side; slug-less falls back to `/app/inbox` | api notification-routes tests |
| 8 | `product_update` fixture subject hit the ASCII `label` whitelist (`é` rejected) | Fixture uses a controlled-token subject — the whitelist is working as designed | contracts test green |

## Evidence report

Stage A is complete against the ticket's eight in-scope items:

1. **Full §5.11 in-app matrix** — 13 event types, one `NOTIFICATION_MATRIX` row each; in-app
   delivery rides the same `notify` event stream + server-side prefs as PRB.09's mailer
   (collapse-in-place on `run_id`/`collapse_key`; non-configurable = spend_gate/trial_payment;
   `osLevelOnlyWhenUnfocused` declared for the 1.x `NotificationTransport` seam).
2. **`/app/inbox`** — shared `inboxOrder`/`inboxBadgeCount` (findings-core, framework-free);
   badge counts approvals + decisions only; a gate row's expand mounts the real card
   (read-before-Approve, REQ-MOBILE-10).
3. **Decisions rows** — escalations, horizon-expired deferrals ("decide / re-defer / drop"),
   and §6.8 stall escalations (now firing for hand-run rounds) all land in `decision_requests`
   and resolve through P0.12's real transitions.
4. **REQ-IDE-48 landing** — unread finished run ⇒ walkthrough card with the workflow-shaped
   deliverable; `runLandingPath` maps review/fact_check → dossier, draft-likes → `/v/working`,
   figures → `/figures`.
5. **Quiet hours** — `visible_at` deferral for `run_finished`/`chat_reply` only; the mail leg
   reschedules to window end; gates/spend never defer; the two non-configurable rows refuse
   PUT-disable with 400.
6. **Phone width <768** — compact propagation end-to-end; the §10.1 input set renders (gate
   card + estimate, five dispositions + note, text-only chat); the ✗ column asserts absent in
   `inbox-phone.test.ts`; no app banner; the 1280/1024 intermediates are pinned in the
   generated CSS.
7. **Deferred email rows** — voice-stale weekly digest (`notify.sweep.weekly`), day-12 trial +
   payment-failed (`notify.sweep.daily`), optional hourly run-finished digest
   (`notify.sweep.hourly` + `digest` pref), product updates opt-in off-by-default; templates
   keep the Wait-for-me/Open-only action set.
8. **Stage B** — deferred to `D-P1.19-1` (deploy + live notify legs ≤$10) and `D-P1.19-2`
   (~375 px device smoke). No prior OPEN row was unblocked by this ticket; none closed.

Spend: **$0** (Stage A only). Merge: operator-held; PR base `stevevitali/p1-18-export`.
